mapper.sql: ai.id, ai.title, ai.content, ai.course_id, ai.teacher_id, ai.publish_time, ai.due_time, ai.attachment_path
mapper.insert: insert into assignment_info (title, content, course_id, teacher_id, publish_time, due_time, attachment_path) values (#{title}, #{content}, #{courseId}, #{teacherId}, #{publishTime}, #{dueTime}, #{attachmentPath})
mapper.select: select , c.name as courseName, t.name as teacherName from assignment_info ai left join course c on ai.course_id = c.id left join teacher t on ai.teacher_id = t.id where ai.id = #{id}

select , c.name as courseName, t.name as teacherName from assignment_info ai left join course c on ai.course_id = c.id left join teacher t on ai.teacher_id = t.id where ai.course_id = #{courseId} order by ai.publish_time desc, ai.id desc

select , c.name as courseName, t.name as teacherName from assignment_info ai left join course c on ai.course_id = c.id left join teacher t on ai.teacher_id = t.id where ai.teacher_id = #{teacherId} order by ai.publish_time desc, ai.id desc
